rationale: The local @benchmark decorator enrolls the function into BENCHMARKS[func.__name__]; run() selects it via the computed key BENCHMARKS[args.name] and run_benchmark awaits bench(hass). run() is itself dispatched by homeassistant/scripts/__init__.py via importlib. This is exactly the registration-decorator-into-dispatch-table, computed-key invocation pattern that registration-decorator-dispatch describes; @benchmark is just not in its curated decorator set.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior fp-classifier-regression verdict naming registration-decorator-dispatch is correct.
